(Currently Amended) 1. An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device is configured to dynamically adjust the alignment based on real-time user feedback.

(Currently Amended) 2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and determines whether user actions correspond to this current step based on user interaction data.

(Currently Amended) 3. The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is updated based on user progress indicated by demonstrated actions.

(Currently Amended) 4. The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, thereby facilitating user comprehension of the procedure.

(Currently Amended) 5. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, taking into account potential user action trajectories.

(Currently Amended) 6. The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the next step mark is dynamically modified based on user interaction feedback.

(Currently Amended) 7. The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, ensuring visibility for user guidance throughout the procedure.

(Currently Amended) 11. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to actively performing the documented procedure and engages the user through adaptive learning mechanisms.

(Currently Amended) 12. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein said extraction is enhanced through user interaction data analysis.
